sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日简报》节目。

sentences.en: As Kamala Harris successfully re-energizes the Democratic Party, her campaign is now trying
sentences.zh: 随着卡玛拉·哈里斯成功地为民主党注入了新的活力，她的竞选团队现在正试图

sentences.en: to figure out how to translate that excitement into a winning coalition of voters in November.
sentences.zh: 弄清楚如何将这种兴奋转化为十一月份获胜的选民联盟。

sentences.en: Today, my colleagues travel to the swing state of Wisconsin, where a group of skeptical voters may represent Harris' single biggest challenge.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事前往摇摆州威斯康星州，那里的一群持怀疑态度的选民可能代表了哈里斯面临的最大挑战。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, August 8th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月8日，星期四。

sentences.en: Reid Epstein.
sentences.zh: 里德·爱泼斯坦。

sentences.en: Welcome back.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回来。

sentences.en: Hi, Michael.
sentences.zh: 你好，迈克尔。

sentences.en: So, Reid, from the moment that Joe Biden left this race and Kamala Harris replaced him as the presumptive Democratic nominee, the promise was that she would do better than Biden
sentences.zh: 那么，里德，从乔·拜登退出竞选、卡玛拉·哈里斯接替他成为民主党推定提名人的那一刻起，人们的期望就是她会比拜登

sentences.en: ever could against Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 在对抗唐纳德·特朗普时表现得更好。

sentences.en: But the specifics of that, of how she would do better, felt a little bit vague.
sentences.zh: 但关于她如何做得更好的具体细节，感觉有点模糊。

sentences.en: And that's what we want to talk to you about today.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们今天想和你讨论的内容。

sentences.en: We've had a few weeks to better understand that proposition.
sentences.zh: 我们已经有几周的时间来更好地理解这一主张了。

sentences.en: So, what does a winning Harris coalition in November look like?
sentences.zh: 那么，十一月份哈里斯的获胜联盟会是什么样子？

sentences.en: And how does it compare with the support that Biden had been getting?
sentences.zh: 它与拜登之前获得的支持相比如何？

sentences.en: So, Michael, I think the place to start is not two and a half weeks ago when Biden got out of the race, but four years ago when he defeated Donald Trump and won the White House.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我认为切入点不应该是两周半前拜登退出竞选的时候，而是四年前他击败唐纳德·特朗普并赢得白宫的时候。

sentences.en: In that race, he won a bunch of states that Trump had won in 2016.
sentences.zh: 在那场竞选中，他赢得了许多特朗普在2016年赢得的州。

sentences.en: He won Michigan and Wisconsin and Pennsylvania in the Midwestern Blue Wall states.
sentences.zh: 他赢得了密歇根州、威斯康星州和宾夕法尼亚州这些中西部的“蓝墙”州。

sentences.en: And he won in the Sun Belt in Georgia and Arizona, and he held on to Nevada.
sentences.zh: 他还赢得了佐治亚州和亚利桑那州的阳光地带，并守住了内华达州。

sentences.en: In that election, Biden assembled a coalition with three essential elements for any Democrat to win a national election.
sentences.zh: 在那次选举中，拜登组建了一个联盟，其中包含任何民主党人赢得全国选举所必需的三个要素。

sentences.en: He drove up turnout in big cities, particularly among people of color and young voters.
sentences.zh: 他提高了大城市的投票率，特别是有色人种和年轻选民的投票率。

sentences.en: He did better than Hillary Clinton had with college-educated voters in the suburbs.
sentences.zh: 他在郊区受过大学教育的选民中的表现比希拉里·克林顿要好。

sentences.en: And he did something that has been trickier in the Trump era.
sentences.zh: 他还做了一件在特朗普时代更棘手的事情。

sentences.en: He limited his losses among white working class and rural voters.
sentences.zh: 他限制了自己在白人蓝领和农村选民中的损失。

sentences.en: Biden had an image as Scranton Joe and somebody who had been in every union hall in the country
sentences.zh: 拜登拥有“斯克兰顿的乔”的形象，他曾去过全国每一个工会大厅，

sentences.en: and was familiar to some of these rural white voters as the type of Democrat that they used to vote for when they were voting for Democrats.
sentences.zh: 对于一些农村白人选民来说，他很熟悉，是那种他们过去投票支持民主党时会选择的民主党人。

sentences.en: So now, place Kamala Harris into that same dynamic.
sentences.zh: 那么现在，把卡玛拉·哈里斯放进同样的动态中。

sentences.en: So, Michael, what all the polling and models tell us at this point is that Harris has to replicate much of that 2020 Biden coalition to win.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，目前所有的民调和模型都告诉我们，哈里斯必须复制2020年拜登联盟的大部分才能获胜。

sentences.en: But she's not the same person, right?
sentences.zh: 但她不是同一个人，对吧？

sentences.en: She's not an older white guy from Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 她不是来自宾夕法尼亚州的老白人男性。

sentences.en: She is a Black and South Asian woman from San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 她是来自旧金山的黑人和南亚裔女性。

sentences.en: And so the question for her in the last couple weeks has been, what elements of the Biden coalition can she put back together or even exceed?
sentences.zh: 所以过去几周她面临的问题是，她能重新整合拜登联盟的哪些部分，甚至超越它？

sentences.en: And who from his voters would be turned off by her as the candidate?
sentences.zh: 又有谁会因为她是候选人而对拜登的选民群体产生反感？

sentences.en: And what we've seen in the last couple weeks from Harris is that she has engendered an enormous
sentences.zh: 我们在过去几周从哈里斯身上看到的是，她激发了巨大的

sentences.en: amount of enthusiasm and excitement from precisely the part of the coalition that Biden was weakest with, young people and people of color.
sentences.zh: 热情和兴奋，恰恰来自拜登最薄弱的联盟部分：年轻人和有色人种。

sentences.en: But one of the risks for her is that among the white working class and rural voters where Biden
sentences.zh: 但对她来说，风险之一是在白人蓝领和农村选民中，拜登

sentences.en: held down the Republican margins, that she may come across differently and be less popular than he was with some of these voters in white rural areas.
sentences.zh: 控制了共和党的优势，而她可能会给这些白人农村地区的选民留下不同的印象，受欢迎程度不如他。

sentences.en: Okay, well, given that, what would Harris need to do to replicate Biden's performance with these white working class and rural communities in the swing states we're talking about?
sentences.zh: 好的，鉴于此，哈里斯需要做些什么才能在我们谈论的这些摇摆州中，复制拜登在白人蓝领和农村社区的表现？

sentences.en: Well, let's look at Wisconsin, which I know we talk about a lot.
sentences.zh: 嗯，让我们看看威斯康星州，我知道我们经常谈论它。

sentences.en: It's a state with a lot of rural counties that fit into this dynamic that Harris will have to figure out on this campaign.
sentences.zh: 这是一个拥有许多农村县的州，符合哈里斯在这场竞选中必须解决的这种动态。

sentences.en: And one good example is Dunn County in the western part of the state.
sentences.zh: 一个很好的例子是该州西部的邓恩县。

sentences.en: It is a place that twice voted for Obama and then twice voted for Trump.
sentences.zh: 这是一个两次投票给奥巴马，然后两次投票给特朗普的地方。

sentences.en: In 2020, Trump won there by 14 percentage points, which was about 3,300 votes more than Biden received.
sentences.zh: 2020年，特朗普在那里以14个百分点的优势获胜，比拜登多获得了约3,300张选票。

sentences.en: And Harris needs to, at the very least, match Biden's performance there, or maybe have the margin be a little bit less.
sentences.zh: 哈里斯至少需要匹配拜登在那里的表现，或者让差距缩小一点。

sentences.en: You know, if she loses to Trump by 12 points and not 14, that's a small amount.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果她输给特朗普12个百分点而不是14个，那是一个很小的数额。

sentences.en: But if you repeat that pattern across the 65 rural counties in Wisconsin, this is a phenomenon that really matters.
sentences.zh: 但如果你在威斯康星州的65个农村县重复这种模式，这确实是一个很重要的问题。

sentences.en: It's sort of a counterintuitive way to think about how you win in that it's about minimizing your losses.
sentences.zh: 这是一种反直觉的获胜思维方式，因为它关乎如何将损失降到最低。

sentences.en: You're basically saying that how little Harris loses in these white working class rural districts really matters because it really adds up.
sentences.zh: 你基本上是在说，哈里斯在这些白人蓝领农村选区输得越少越重要，因为这真的会积少成多。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And that's really the story of these upper Midwest states that she needs to win.
sentences.zh: 这确实是她需要赢得的这些中西部北部州的故事。

sentences.en: The picture is pretty similar in Michigan and Pennsylvania.
sentences.zh: 密歇根州和宾夕法尼亚州的情况也差不多。

sentences.en: She has to do well in the cities and the suburbs.
sentences.zh: 她必须在城市和郊区表现出色。

sentences.en: But she also has to make enough inroads in these rural communities like Biden did to prevent Trump
sentences.zh: 但她也必须像拜登那样在这些农村社区取得足够的进展，以防止特朗普

sentences.en: from running up margins so large that it discounts whatever she takes from the cities.
sentences.zh: 获得如此大的优势，从而抵消她在城市中取得的任何成果。

sentences.en: And that's sort of what we're all trying to figure out right now.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们现在都在试图弄清楚的事情。

sentences.en: What does it look like for the Harris campaign to try to win over these white working class and rural
sentences.zh: 哈里斯竞选团队试图赢得这些白人蓝领和农村

sentences.en: voters and stitch back together the coalition that elected Joe Biden four years ago?
sentences.zh: 选民，并重新拼凑出四年前选举乔·拜登的联盟，这看起来是什么样的？

sentences.en: How is her campaign trying to reach those voters?
sentences.zh: 她的竞选团队是如何试图接触这些选民的？

sentences.en: And is what they're doing working?
sentences.zh: 他们所做的事情有效吗？

sentences.en: And there's really only one way to begin to answer that, which is to be in one of these rural counties and watch it up close.
sentences.zh: 要回答这个问题，真的只有一个办法，那就是深入其中一个农村县，近距离观察。

sentences.en: Why don't I set up my computer too?
sentences.zh: 为什么我不也把我的电脑架起来呢？

sentences.en: Shortly after Biden dropped out of the race, my colleagues, Daily Producers Jessica Chung and Stella Tan,
sentences.zh: 在拜登退出竞选后不久，我的同事，《每日简报》制片人杰西卡·钟和斯特拉·谭，

sentences.en: traveled to Dunn County in Wisconsin, the largely white working class community that Reid had mentioned.
sentences.zh: 前往了里德提到的威斯康星州邓恩县，这是一个以白人蓝领为主的社区。

sentences.en: Hi, good morning.
sentences.zh: 嗨，早上好。

sentences.en: Hi, morning.
sentences.zh: 嗨，早上好。

sentences.en: How are you doing?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: Good, how are you?
sentences.zh: 很好，你呢？

sentences.en: And they arrived, just as the Harris campaign was kicking off an intense door-to-door outreach out there.
sentences.zh: 她们到达时，哈里斯竞选团队正开始在那里进行密集的挨家挨户宣传活动。

sentences.en: I'm Pete.
sentences.zh: 我是皮特。

sentences.en: You're Pete.
sentences.zh: 你是皮特。

sentences.en: Hi, nice to meet you.
sentences.zh: 嗨，很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: How was your travels in?
sentences.zh: 你们的旅程怎么样？

sentences.en: Very pleasant.
sentences.zh: 非常愉快。

sentences.en: We had cheese curds last night.
sentences.zh: 我们昨晚吃了奶酪凝乳。

sentences.en: Everyone's been recommending them, so it was the first thing we did, basically.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在推荐它们，所以这基本上是我们做的第一件事。

sentences.en: Very good.
sentences.zh: 非常好。

sentences.en: Jessica Chung begins the story.
sentences.zh: 杰西卡·钟开始了报道。

sentences.en: Well, welcome, welcome.
sentences.zh: 欢迎，欢迎。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Glad you're here.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你们能来。

sentences.en: We arrived at the Dunn County Democratic Party office just six days after Biden dropped out.
sentences.zh: 我们在拜登退选六天后到达了邓恩县民主党办公室。

sentences.en: This office is on the side of a state highway in the small city of Menominee, Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 这个办公室位于威斯康星州梅诺莫尼市的一条州际公路旁。

sentences.en: It's wedged between a property management company and a laundromat.
sentences.zh: 它夹在一家物业管理公司和一家自助洗衣店之间。

sentences.en: I would love to, like, maybe start with a tour of the offices.
sentences.zh: 我很想，比如，先参观一下办公室。

sentences.en: Like, I know it's not that big, but...
sentences.zh: 我知道它不是很大，但是……

sentences.en: Sure, yeah, you might be looking at it.
sentences.zh: 当然，是的，你可能正在看它。

sentences.en: Pete Huff is the county chair here, helping Democrats get elected up and down the ticket.
sentences.zh: 皮特·赫夫是这里的县主席，帮助民主党人竞选各级职位。

sentences.en: We have everything from our county clerk's race through to Congress.
sentences.zh: 我们有从县书记官竞选到国会竞选的一切。

sentences.en: One of the first things that catches my eye are all the lawn signs leaning against the wall.
sentences.zh: 引起我注意的第一件事是靠在墙上的所有草坪标语牌。

sentences.en: I see one sign on the far end there that might be a little outdated now.
sentences.zh: 我看到最远端有一个标语牌，现在可能有点过时了。

sentences.en: Yeah, we have the Biden-Harris signs.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们有拜登-哈里斯的标语牌。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: This place is a small office in the middle of a huge transition.
sentences.zh: 这个地方是一个处于巨大转型中的小办公室。

sentences.en: After switching presidential candidates less than a week ago, there hasn't even been time to print new Kamala Harris swag.
sentences.zh: 在不到一周前更换总统候选人后，甚至没有时间印制新的卡玛拉·哈里斯周边产品。

sentences.en: What question do I get at least three times a day?
sentences.zh: 我每天至少被问到三次的问题是什么？

sentences.en: It's like, when can I get my new Harris sign?
sentences.zh: 就像是，我什么时候能拿到我的新哈里斯标语牌？

sentences.en: And then I've seen people that are just making their own signs that say Kamala, like arts and crafts style.
sentences.zh: 然后我看到人们只是自己制作写着“卡玛拉”的标语牌，就像手工制作风格的那样。

sentences.en: But while the Harris swag hasn't shown up yet, what had started to show up were volunteers.
sentences.zh: 但虽然哈里斯的周边产品还没出现，但开始出现的是志愿者。

sentences.en: Martha here is our volunteer coordinator.
sentences.zh: 玛莎是我们的志愿者协调员。

sentences.en: She's obviously signing people up.
sentences.zh: 她显然正在给人们登记。

sentences.en: Hi, I heard my name.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我听到有人叫我的名字。

sentences.en: I'm Aunt Martha, everybody.
sentences.zh: 我是玛莎阿姨，大家好。

sentences.en: Over 50 calls me, so that can be...
sentences.zh: 50岁以上的人都叫我这个，所以这可能是……

sentences.en: Aunt Martha.
sentences.zh: 玛莎阿姨。

sentences.en: Well, you know, it's easier to remember my name.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道，记住我的名字更容易。

sentences.en: Everybody's got an Aunt Martha or knows one, you know.
sentences.zh: 每个人都有一个玛莎阿姨，或者认识一个，你知道的。

sentences.en: Aunt Martha is in charge of coordinating the volunteers here.
sentences.zh: 玛莎阿姨负责协调这里的志愿者。

sentences.en: Monday, Wednesday, Friday, 2 to 6.
sentences.zh: 周一、周三、周五，2点到6点。

sentences.en: She shows me her schedule that's laid out on this big calendar sitting on our desk.
sentences.zh: 她向我展示了她放在桌上大日历上的时间表。

sentences.en: And it looks pretty packed, full of people raising their hands to do phone banking and door knocking.
sentences.zh: 看起来排得很满，到处都是举手报名参加电话拉票和敲门拜访的人。

sentences.en: In the week that this campaign office has transformed from one for Joe Biden to one for Kamala Harris.
sentences.zh: 在这一周里，这个竞选办公室已经从乔·拜登的办公室转变为卡玛拉·哈里斯的办公室。

sentences.en: It's amazing.
sentences.zh: 太神奇了。

sentences.en: Have you seen a delusion of volunteers?
sentences.zh: 你看到志愿者的涌入了吗？

sentences.en: Oh my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Oh my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: The money is flowing in.
sentences.zh: 资金源源不断地涌入。

sentences.en: And the money and the people...
sentences.zh: 资金和人……

sentences.en: I can't keep this door closed.
sentences.zh: 我没法关上这扇门。

sentences.en: What motivated you to volunteer and not just be a voter?
sentences.zh: 是什么促使你成为志愿者，而不仅仅是一名选民？

sentences.en: Is it Kamala?
sentences.zh: 是因为卡玛拉吗？

sentences.en: Oh, for sure.
sentences.zh: 哦，当然。

sentences.en: For sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: And did you do any kind of canvassing for Joe Biden?
sentences.zh: 你为乔·拜登做过任何形式的拉票活动吗？

sentences.en: Absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 绝对没有。

sentences.en: People are coming out of the woodwork to volunteer, to donate money.
sentences.zh: 人们纷纷出来做志愿者，捐款。

sentences.en: I woke up Monday so happy.
sentences.zh: 我周一醒来时非常高兴。

sentences.en: And I'm thinking to myself, why are you so happy?
sentences.zh: 我在想，你为什么这么高兴？

sentences.en: And I'm like, oh my God, it's because of Kamala.
sentences.zh: 然后我想，天哪，是因为卡玛拉。

sentences.en: I think there's that spark that's there now, that newfound energy.
sentences.zh: 我认为现在有一种火花，那种新发现的能量。

sentences.en: There's just an energy and a fun to it that is encouraging.
sentences.zh: 这其中有一种能量和乐趣，非常鼓舞人心。

sentences.en: They come in, they want t-shirts.
sentences.zh: 他们进来，想要T恤。

sentences.en: They brought in her book yesterday, the Kamala Harris book.
sentences.zh: 他们昨天带来了她的书，那本卡玛拉·哈里斯的书。

sentences.en: You know, we have a little library there.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们那里有一个小图书馆。

sentences.en: Basically, it was like you have two old men and you don't like either one of them.
sentences.zh: 基本上，就像你有两个老头子，你两个都不喜欢。

sentences.en: Now we don't have that.

sentences.en: The challenge for the Harris campaign, of course, is to figure out how to take all that energy and turn it into votes.

sentences.en: For Democrats in Dunn County, that means trying to convince people to support her in a place that's become largely very friendly to Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 对于邓恩县的民主党人来说，这意味着要在一个对唐纳德·特朗普非常友好的地方，努力说服人们支持她。

sentences.en: That's just a reality of we're in a conservative stronghold.

sentences.en: I would say it's pretty working class.

sentences.en: You'll see signs on people's doors that say, please don't ring the bell or knock.
sentences.zh: 你会看到人们门上贴着告示，写着请勿按铃或敲门。

sentences.en: I'm a shift worker and I'm a night shift worker.
sentences.zh: 我是轮班工人，还是夜班工人。

sentences.en: Pete's pretty realistic about the challenges facing the campaign here.
sentences.zh: 皮特对竞选团队在这里面临的挑战非常务实。

sentences.en: We don't expect that we're going to be the place where Harris is going to win by an overwhelming majority.
sentences.zh: 我们并不指望这里会成为哈里斯以压倒性优势获胜的地方。

sentences.en: But our job here is that we keep it as close as we possibly can to make sure that we keep it competitive.
sentences.zh: 但我们的工作是尽可能缩小差距，确保选情保持竞争性。

sentences.en: Remember, Harris will almost certainly lose Dunn County.
sentences.zh: 记住，哈里斯几乎肯定会输掉邓恩县。

sentences.en: The goal is for her to lose it by less than Biden did, which is about 3,300 votes.
sentences.zh: 目标是让她输掉的票数比拜登少，也就是大约3300张选票。

sentences.en: And when you boil that down, it's about 50 votes per precinct.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，每个选区大约需要争取50张选票。

sentences.en: We can do that.
sentences.zh: 我们能做到。

sentences.en: If we have the money, we can absolutely turn 50 votes per precinct for Kamala.
sentences.zh: 如果我们有资金，我们绝对能为卡玛拉在每个选区争取到50张选票。

sentences.en: No problem.
sentences.zh: 没问题。

sentences.en: Pete says that there are a couple of key voting groups that the campaign thinks can help them do that.
sentences.zh: 皮特说，竞选团队认为有几个关键选民群体可以帮助他们实现这一目标。

sentences.en: One is young voters, but there's another big one.
sentences.zh: 一个是年轻选民，但还有另一个重要的群体。

sentences.en: Female voters in particular, those are the ones that are going to switch and really make the difference.
sentences.zh: 尤其是女性选民，她们是会倒戈并真正带来改变的人。

sentences.en: And that's women.
sentences.zh: 那就是女性。

sentences.en: So would you say that if there was a white whale in this election, the kind of voter would be a female voter?

sentences.en: I think that absolutely.

sentences.en: They're the most persuadable.
sentences.zh: 她们是最容易被说服的。

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 我也这么认为。

sentences.en: And if you look...
sentences.zh: 如果你看看……

sentences.en: Pete feels women are persuadable, in part because of how well women candidates have been doing statewide.
sentences.zh: 皮特觉得女性是可以被说服的，部分原因是女性候选人在全州范围内的表现一直很好。

sentences.en: Wisconsin Senator Tammy Baldwin has done really well in recent elections.
sentences.zh: 威斯康星州参议员塔米·鲍德温在最近的选举中表现非常出色。

sentences.en: Also, in a big Supreme Court race just last year, voters in Dunn County helped elect a liberal judge, Judge Janet Protosewitch.
sentences.zh: 此外，就在去年的一场重要的最高法院竞选中，邓恩县的选民帮助选出了一位自由派法官，珍妮特·普罗托塞维奇法官。

sentences.en: Pete saw both of those races up close.
sentences.zh: 皮特近距离观察了这两场竞选。

sentences.en: We know that the folks that were really backing her from our doors and from our conversations were women voters.
sentences.zh: 我们知道，那些通过登门拜访和交谈真正支持她的，正是女性选民。

sentences.en: We can follow that template from last April in this presidential election and get Kamala elected.
sentences.zh: 我们可以在这次总统大选中沿用去年四月的模式，让卡玛拉当选。

sentences.en: Do you lose a white whale with Kamala now?
sentences.zh: 你现在觉得卡玛拉能拿下那个“白鲸”吗？

sentences.en: Like you mentioned that college students and women are going to be crucial, that Kamala is helping buoy that kind of demographic of voter.
sentences.zh: 就像你提到的，大学生和女性将是关键，卡玛拉正在帮助提振这类选民群体。

sentences.en: But the ones that Joe Biden carried among white voters, do you think that she might have a harder time winning over those voters than Joe Biden did?
sentences.zh: 但对于乔·拜登在白人选民中获得的那些支持，你认为她赢得这些选民的难度会比乔·拜登大吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I wish I had the magic crystal ball.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我希望我有一个神奇的水晶球。

sentences.en: But I don't know any Democrats that were like pro-Joe.
sentences.zh: 但我认识的民主党人里，没有谁是那种“铁杆挺拜”的。

sentences.en: And now they're like, oh, I'm thinking about Trump because of Kamala.
sentences.zh: 然后现在他们说，哦，因为卡玛拉，我正在考虑投给特朗普。

sentences.en: It's like, that's just not a thing for us.
sentences.zh: 这在我们这里根本不存在。

sentences.en: If anything, it's that we had folks that were like on the Trump bandwagon that don't really want to be on it.
sentences.zh: 如果有的话，那就是我们有一些人曾经站在特朗普的阵营里，但其实并不想待在那里。

sentences.en: But they didn't really feel like they could get off of it.
sentences.zh: 但他们觉得没法脱身。

sentences.en: And there's something now that feels like—

sentences.en: Pete saying the strategy even includes some Republicans who are looking to break away from the party, and now might be willing to, with Harris at the top of the ticket.
sentences.zh: 皮特说，策略甚至包括争取一些想要脱离共和党的选民，现在有了哈里斯领衔，他们可能愿意转投阵营。

sentences.en: But the final piece of the puzzle, Pete says, is making sure that Democrats actually turn out to vote.
sentences.zh: 但皮特说，拼图的最后一块是确保民主党人真的出来投票。

sentences.en: And they had all that stuff.

sentences.zh: 他们非常友好。

sentences.zh: 我问，你们觉得乔·拜登怎么样？

sentences.zh: 这是在他决定退选之前。

sentences.en: And they said, like, I guess.

sentences.zh: 就是那种不太感兴趣的样子。

sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: And it was like, not the answer you want to get from a household that's like,

sentences.zh: 我敢保证，如果我回去问他们，嘿，你们对卡玛拉·哈里斯感觉如何？

sentences.en: And I guarantee, like, those are the folks that were, if I were to go back and say, like, hey, like, how do you feel about Kamala Harris?
sentences.zh: 根据那次谈话，我有预感，他们可能会更有动力。

sentences.zh: 现在有一种感觉，卡玛拉·哈里斯就是我们国家的未来。

sentences.zh: 噢，你好。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: How you doing?
sentences.zh: 你好吗？

sentences.en: I'm Pete with the Dunn County Democrats.
sentences.zh: 我是邓恩县民主党人的皮特。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Do you have a minute to chat?
sentences.zh: 你有空聊一分钟吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: And we meet a woman named Kate.
sentences.zh: 我们遇到了一位名叫凯特的女士。

sentences.en: She says she's 38.
sentences.zh: 她说她38岁。

sentences.en: I'm Kate.
sentences.zh: 我是凯特。
我38岁。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: I had to think about that for a sec.
sentences.zh: 我刚才还想了一下。

sentences.en: And she works in mortgages.
sentences.zh: 她是做抵押贷款工作的。

sentences.en: Just chatting with folks about the upcoming election.
sentences.zh: 只是和大家聊聊即将到来的选举。

sentences.en: Harris is running for president.
sentences.zh: 哈里斯正在竞选总统。

sentences.en: Or is it just kind of curious?
sentences.zh: 还是说只是有点好奇？

sentences.en: Like, what are you thinking about that?
sentences.zh: 比如，你是怎么想的？

sentences.en: It is what it is, I guess.
sentences.zh: 我想，现状就是这样吧。

sentences.en: You typically vote Democrat?
sentences.zh: 你通常投给民主党吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Harris, how do you feel?
sentences.zh: 哈里斯，你感觉如何？

sentences.en: You think she's...
sentences.zh: 你觉得她……

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I'm glad it's not Biden.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴不是拜登。

sentences.en: He's too old.
sentences.zh: 他太老了。

sentences.en: And on paper, Kate would seem to be the kind of voter, the kind of Democratic voter, that
sentences.zh: 从纸面上看，凯特似乎就是那种皮特希望现在能被哈里斯激励的选民，那种民主党选民。

sentences.en: Pete hoped might now be motivated by Harris.
sentences.zh: 那种民主党选民。

sentences.en: You know, with Harris, you kind of feel like you just got to get to know her more?
sentences.zh: 你知道，对于哈里斯，你是不是觉得还需要更多地了解她？

sentences.en: Or is it something about her that don't like her issues?
sentences.zh: 还是说她有什么地方让你不喜欢她的主张？

sentences.en: I don't think I know enough about her.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我对她了解得还不够。

sentences.en: And she's been vice president.
sentences.zh: 而且她一直都是副总统。

sentences.en: And to me, that just seems like a placeholder position.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，那看起来就像是一个占位符职位。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: Like, you don't do a whole lot as vice president.
sentences.zh: 就像是，作为副总统你做不了太多事。

sentences.en: But I don't want her, like, winning just because she's a woman of color, a woman.
sentences.zh: 但我不想让她仅仅因为是有色人种女性、因为是女性就获胜。

sentences.en: Not just because you check those boxes.
sentences.zh: 不能仅仅因为你勾选了那些选项。

sentences.en: That doesn't seem like a fair win either.
sentences.zh: 那看起来也不像是一场公平的胜利。

sentences.en: Were you going to vote for Joe no matter what, or...?
sentences.zh: 你本来打算无论如何都要投给乔吗，还是……？

sentences.en: Better of the two crap options, honestly.
sentences.zh: 老实说，是两个烂选项里稍微好一点的那个。

sentences.en: I think even my husband was leaning towards, like, whoever was independent.
sentences.zh: 我想甚至我丈夫也倾向于，比如，投给任何独立候选人。

sentences.en: So it seems like Kamala might be a better option, but maybe just has to do a little bit more work to kind of get you fully excited about her candidacy.
sentences.zh: 所以看起来卡玛拉可能是一个更好的选择，但也许她需要多做一点工作，才能让你对她的竞选真正感到兴奋。

sentences.en: And if she was the one that knocked on your door today, did you give her any advice?
sentences.zh: 如果今天敲你门的是她，你会给她什么建议吗？

sentences.en: No, not really.
sentences.zh: 不，没什么特别的。

sentences.en: I'd be like, why are you here?
sentences.zh: 我会说，你为什么来这儿？

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊，是啊，是啊。

sentences.en: But probably, like, try and meet in the middle as much as you can.
sentences.zh: 但大概会说，尽量寻求中间立场吧。

sentences.en: Like, make it look like a good faith effort.
sentences.zh: 比如，表现出一种善意的努力。

sentences.en: Because right now it just seems like you're playing up this side, and they're the enemy.
sentences.zh: 因为现在看起来你们只是在吹捧这一边，而把对方当成敌人。

sentences.en: And, like, the other side is playing up this side, and they're the enemy.
sentences.zh: 而且，另一边也在吹捧这一边，把对方当成敌人。

sentences.en: And I'm like, there isn't any compromise, I would say.
sentences.zh: 所以我说，根本没有任何妥协。

sentences.en: At the end of their conversation...
sentences.zh: 在他们谈话结束时……

sentences.en: Well, I really appreciate you taking time out of your day to talk.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我真的很感谢你抽出时间来交谈。

sentences.en: I did leave some literature on your front door.
sentences.zh: 我在你前门留了一些宣传资料。

sentences.en: Pete leaves Kate with some of the outdated Biden-Harris pamphlets he has.
sentences.zh: 皮特给凯特留下了一些他手头过时的拜登-哈里斯宣传册。

sentences.en: Appreciate your time here with us.
sentences.zh: 感谢你抽出时间陪我们。

sentences.en: And he walks away.
sentences.zh: 然后他走开了。

sentences.en: Can I actually catch you for a couple more minutes?
sentences.zh: 我能再耽误你几分钟吗？

sentences.en: But I wanted to stay behind and talk more with Kate to try to understand why a Democratic voter sounded so resigned about the choices before her in this election, even with a new
sentences.zh: 但我还是想留下来和凯特多聊聊，试图理解为什么一位民主党选民在这次选举中对面前的选择感到如此无奈，即使有了一位新的

sentences.en: candidate at the top of the ticket.
sentences.zh: 候选人领跑竞选。

sentences.en: And why all of the hope and excitement we heard from Democratic volunteers, why she seemed to feel none of that at all.
sentences.zh: 以及为什么我们从民主党志愿者那里听到的所有希望和兴奋，在她身上似乎一点也感受不到。

sentences.en: Do you know who you plan to vote for for president?
sentences.zh: 你知道你打算投给谁当总统吗？

sentences.en: I mean, if I had to pick today, it would probably be Kamala, even though I'm juSt...
sentences.zh: 我是说，如果我今天必须选，那可能还是卡玛拉，尽管我只是……

sentences.en: There just doesn't seem to be anything that gets done, period.
sentences.zh: 似乎根本没有任何事情能做成，句号。

sentences.en: It's just more belief in the, like, Democratic Party viewpoint.
sentences.zh: 这更多是对民主党观点的信仰。

sentences.en: More like helping out in the community and, like, your neighbors.
sentences.zh: 更像是帮助社区，还有你的邻居。

sentences.en: Like, it doesn't matter if they have 14 million Biden stickers all over their house or, like,
sentences.zh: 就像是，不管他们房子上贴了1400万张拜登贴纸，还是，

sentences.en: 800 Trump flags.
sentences.zh: 800面特朗普旗帜。

sentences.en: It's like you still deserve to get assistance and help available when you need it, so.
sentences.zh: 就像是你仍然应该在需要时得到援助和帮助，所以。

sentences.en: As Kate's telling me this, her daughter walks up to us on the front lawn and peeks out from behind her leg.
sentences.zh: 当凯特跟我说这些时，她的女儿走到我们面前的草坪上，从她腿后探出头来。

sentences.en: Are there any issues that are concerning for you that you wish Kamala would speak more about?
sentences.zh: 有什么问题是你担心的，希望卡玛拉能多谈谈的吗？

sentences.en: I honestly don't know what she's speaking about, but I definitely know there's been a lot about reproductive rights and being a mom of two daughters.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我不知道她在谈论什么，但我肯定知道有很多关于生育权利的内容，作为一个有两个女儿的母亲。

sentences.en: They need their rights.
sentences.zh: 她们需要她们的权利。

sentences.en: You're kind of running your hands through your daughter's hair.
sentences.zh: 你正用手梳理着你女儿的头发。

sentences.en: How old is she?
sentences.zh: 她多大了？

sentences.en: She turns six in a week and a half.
sentences.zh: 再过一周半她就六岁了。

sentences.en: And what's your name?
sentences.zh: 你叫什么名字？

sentences.en: Emma.
sentences.zh: 艾玛。

sentences.en: Emma.
sentences.zh: 艾玛。

sentences.en: Emma.
sentences.zh: 艾玛。

sentences.en: It's a beautiful name.
sentences.zh: 真是个好名字。

sentences.en: Are you hearing Kamala speak about these issues?
sentences.zh: 你有听到卡玛拉谈论这些问题吗？

sentences.en: Not really, but I don't watch the news a great deal.
sentences.zh: 没有，但我不太看新闻。

sentences.en: It's just seems like a lot of arguing and, like, pointing out what the other person does bad.
sentences.zh: 看起来全是争吵，还有指出对方做得有多糟糕。

sentences.en: Like, no, tell me what you're going to do to help me and my family and my children.
sentences.zh: 就像是，不，告诉我你要做什么来帮助我和我的家人以及我的孩子。

sentences.en: I don't care what somebody else is screwing up.
sentences.zh: 我不在乎别人搞砸了什么。

sentences.en: How are you going to make it better?
sentences.zh: 你要怎么让情况变好？

sentences.en: Just don't tell me how Trump is a schmuck, long story short.
sentences.zh: 长话短说，别只告诉我特朗普是个混蛋。

sentences.en: Like, we already know that.
sentences.zh: 我们已经知道了。

sentences.en: Your whole base knows that.
sentences.zh: 你们整个基本盘都知道。

sentences.en: Just talk about ways you're going to bring people together.
sentences.zh: 谈谈你打算如何把人们团结起来的方法吧。

sentences.en: Like, how would you work with them?
sentences.zh: 比如，你会如何与他们合作？

sentences.en: You got to figure out a way to play nice.
sentences.zh: 你得想办法友好相处。

sentences.en: We tell that to children.
sentences.zh: 我们都是这样教育孩子的。

sentences.en: You guys are grownups.
sentences.zh: 你们都是成年人了。

sentences.en: What I heard from Kate was that she feels like both parties are so busy fighting each other that they're not actually doing much to help her family and her community, and that
sentences.zh: 我从凯特那里听到的是，她觉得两个党派都忙于互相攻击，以至于并没有真正做多少事来帮助她的家庭和社区，而且

sentences.en: she's so repulsed by the political system that she's basically tuning out the messages that Democrats are trying to send.
sentences.zh: 她对政治体系感到如此反感，以至于她基本上屏蔽了民主党试图传达的信息。

sentences.en: And at this point, there was nothing about Kamala Harris yet that made her feel differently.
sentences.zh: 而且在这一点上，关于卡玛拉·哈里斯，还没有什么让她感到有什么不同。

sentences.en: And it sounds like you're still waiting for Kamala Harris to show you who she is.
sentences.zh: 听起来你还在等卡玛拉·哈里斯向你展示她是谁。

sentences.en: Show me why she deserves it.
sentences.zh: 向我展示她为什么值得（我的选票）。

sentences.en: So.
sentences.zh: 那么。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Kate, in many ways, reminded me of Emily.
sentences.zh: 凯特在很多方面让我想起了艾米丽。

sentences.en: Even though Emily Lean's Republican and Kate's a Democrat, they both talked about feeling frustrated with politics today.
sentences.zh: 尽管艾米丽倾向于共和党，而凯特是民主党，但她们都谈到了对当今政治感到沮丧。

sentences.en: And even with this massive shakeup in the race, they don't feel like they know enough about
sentences.zh: 即使竞选局势发生了如此巨大的变动，她们仍然觉得对哈里斯了解不够，

sentences.en: Harris yet to know if she's the solution.
sentences.zh: 无法判断她是否就是解决方案。

sentences.en: And that's something we heard from a lot of people we met while door knocking.
sentences.zh: 这是我们在敲门走访时从很多人那里听到的。

sentences.en: Like, what has she actually been doing?
sentences.zh: 比如，她到底做了什么？

sentences.en: I don't know much about her.
sentences.zh: 我对她了解不多。

sentences.en: I'll be completely honeSt.
sentences.zh: 我实话实说吧。

sentences.en: I don't know her yet.
sentences.zh: 我还不太了解她。

sentences.en: So, yeah, just got to do some research on my own.
sentences.zh: 所以，没错，我得自己做些调研。

sentences.en: I don't know that we've really talked about Kamala specifically.
sentences.zh: 我不觉得我们真的专门讨论过卡玛拉。

sentences.en: I mean, I really just don't feel like she's a known entity at this point.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我真的觉得她目前还不算是一个广为人知的人物。

sentences.en: That to them, Harris is kind of a blank canvas.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说，哈里斯就像一张白纸。

sentences.en: And for voters like Emily, that blank canvas could be an opportunity for Pete to project an image and a message that could bring Emily in.
sentences.zh: 而对于像艾米丽这样的选民来说，这张白纸可能是皮特塑造形象和传达信息的一个机会，从而争取到艾米丽的支持。

sentences.en: But for voters like Kate, that blankness could also be a vulnerability, a reason for a skeptical voter or a disaffected voter, even a Democratic one, to turn away or stay home.
sentences.zh: 但对于像凯特这样的选民来说，这种“空白”也可能是一个弱点，会让持怀疑态度或不满的选民，甚至是民主党选民，选择疏远或干脆不去投票。

sentences.en: At the end of today, what do you see to be the biggest challenges for Kamala Harris to win over voters in this area?
sentences.zh: 今天结束时，你认为卡玛拉·哈里斯在争取该地区选民方面面临的最大挑战是什么？

sentences.en: What I heard today is that people need to know her track record and they need to know what her vision is for the United States and to speak to those issues specifically.
sentences.zh: 我今天听到的是，人们需要了解她的过往政绩，需要知道她对美国的愿景，并针对这些问题给出具体的说法。

sentences.en: And I think that there's a lot that people need to learn about her.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为人们还有很多关于她的东西需要了解。

sentences.en: And so we have 99 days to work really hard to educate voters on who this person is and why she's good for Western Wisconsin.
sentences.zh: 所以我们还有99天的时间去努力工作，让选民了解她是谁，以及为什么她对西威斯康星州有利。

sentences.en: Safe travels and thank you for the work that you do.
sentences.zh: 一路平安，感谢你们所做的工作。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Okay, bye.
sentences.zh: 好的，再见。

sentences.en: On Wednesday afternoon, Vice President Harris and her new running mate, Minnesota Governor
sentences.zh: 周三下午，哈里斯副总统和她的新竞选搭档、明尼苏达州州长

sentences.en: Tim Walls, traveled together to Eau Claire, Wisconsin for a rally right next to Dunn County.
sentences.zh: 蒂姆·沃尔兹，一同前往威斯康星州的欧克莱尔，在邓恩县附近举行了一场集会。

sentences.en: Hello, Eau Claire.
sentences.zh: 你们好，欧克莱尔。

sentences.en: Isn't it good to have a candidate who can pronounce the name correctly?
sentences.zh: 有一位能正确念出地名的候选人，感觉真好，不是吗？

sentences.en: There, Walls showcased a life story that the Harris campaign hopes will appeal directly to white working class voters across Wisconsin and the entire MidweSt.
sentences.zh: 在那里，沃尔兹展示了他的人生故事，哈里斯竞选团队希望这能直接吸引威斯康星州乃至整个中西部的白人蓝领选民。

sentences.en: Being a Midwestern or two, I know a little something about commitment to people.
sentences.zh: 作为中西部人，我深知对人民的承诺意味着什么。

sentences.en: I was born in a small town in Nebraska where community meant everything.
sentences.zh: 我出生在内布拉斯加州的一个小镇，在那里社区就是一切。

sentences.en: My mom and dad taught me to show generosity to my neighbors and work for a common good.
sentences.zh: 我的父母教导我要善待邻居，为共同利益而努力。

sentences.en: At 17, I joined the Army National Guard.
sentences.zh: 17岁那年，我加入了陆军国民警卫队。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.zh: 周三，数千名警察在英国各地部署，试图阻止极右翼团体计划的抗议活动演变成进一步的暴力事件。

sentences.en: For the past week, more than a dozen British towns and cities have been rocked by anti-immigrant riots, fueled by far-right agitators.
sentences.zh: 过去一周，英国十几个城镇因极右翼煽动者挑起的反移民骚乱而陷入动荡。
